name = ("run-" + time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ", time.gmtime())
                + "-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:6])
        self.run_dir = base / name
        self.run_dir.mkdir(mode=0o700)
evidence.reason: The code creates `self.run_dir` under the record base and returns it without syncing the base directory. `durable_write` for the receipt syncs the receipt file and its immediate parent (the run directory), not the record base entry that makes the new run directory reachable. A crash after admission can therefore leave the host held while losing the run-directory entry and its recovery evidence. This is an implementation gap in the intended durable recovery evidence.
